== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Captain Piett (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_6</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 06), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-06-Captain_Piett.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-captainpiett-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Captain Piett (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Twice per game during opponent's turn, may place three cards from hand on your Force Pile to draw top two cards from Reserve Deck.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6159</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>3_85</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 06, Virtual Block 2 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
